Talent3_5Ability.name: Creed Of Sin
Talent3_5Ability.SpecificEffects:
Can equip Railgun, Railgun weight reduced by <color=#F74848>-360</color>. Can use command skill <skill mainSkill=601050>[Vengeful Strike]</skill>. When actively attacked, recovers <color=#F74848>1</color> tactical ammo and applies <buf ID=6010502>[Magnetic Lock-On]</buf> to the attacker
For each <color=#F74848>1</color> enemy carrying <buf ID=6010502>[Magnetic Lock-On]</buf>, increases DMG dealt by <color=#F74848>5%</color> and reduces DMG taken by <color=#F74848>5%</color>, up to <color=#F74848>20%</color>. <buf ID=900022>[Guard]</buf> can additionally block missiles and melee attack.

600001.name: Entrenched 1
600001.SpecificEffects: Trigger <buf ID=900022>[Guard]</buf> to protect adjacent (<color=#F74848>1</color> tile) allies from Assault and Ranged attacks, effective up to <color=#F74848>2</color> times per turn.

601002.name: Unconcerned
601002.SpecificEffects: At the end of turn, reload <color=#F74848>1</color> ammo to Railgun magazine

601003.name: Repulsion
601003.SpecificEffects: Reduces DMG taken by <color=#F74848>12.5%</color>. If the attacker carries <buf ID=6010502>[Magnetic Lock-On]</buf>, additionally reduces DMG taken by <color=#F74848>12.5%</color>.

601004.name: An Offer They Cannot Refuse
601004.describe: Attacks <color=#F74848>1</color> enemy within <color=#F74848>5</color> adjacent tiles, as well as all enemies within <range type=1>1-tile cross-shaped</range> area around the target, dealing <color=#F74848>0.5x</color> AoE DMG. After combat, applies <buf ID=6010502>[Magnetic Lock-On]</buf> to all the targets hit, then triggers <buf ID=900004>[Re-ATK]</buf>, cannot move before attacking. This skill can be used <color=#F74848>1</color> time per turn.

601005.name: Tempo Surge
601005.SpecificEffects: When initiating combat against a target carrying <buf ID=6010502>[Magnetic Lock-On]</buf>, applies <buf ID=3006442>[Short Circuit II]</buf> and <buf ID=7101507>[Movement Inhibition II]</buf> to the target before attacking, lasting for <color=#F74848>2</color> turns.

600106.name: Hunting Prelude
600106.SpecificEffects: Throws a powerful magnetic projectile with a Large Shield or Small Shield at any tile within <range type=1>4-tile diamond area</range>, dealing <color=#F74848>0.1x</color> AoE DMG to the body of all enemies within <color=#F74848>3</color> tiles of the target, then forcibly moves them <color=#F74848>2</color> tiles toward the center. Applies <buf ID=6010502>[Magnetic Lock-On]</buf> to all targets hit, and triggers <buf ID=900004>[Re-ATK]</buf> in place.

601007.name: Shared Vengeance
601007.SpecificEffects: When an ally with <color=#F74848>30%</color> or lower HP is attacked, <buf ID=900022>[Guard]</buf> can be triggered regardless of distance. Can trigger <color=#F74848>2</color> times per turn.

601008.name: Luno's Oath
601008.describe: Protects allies within <color=#F74848>2</color> adjacent tiles from assault and ranged attacks. Can trigger <color=#F74848>2</color> times per turn, lasting for <color=#F74848>2</color> turns. After using this skill, fully reloads Railgun ammo magazine and triggers <buf ID=900004>[Re-ATK]</buf>.

600022.name: Armor Specialization 2
600022.SpecificEffects: When performing <buf ID=900022>[Guard]</buf>, restore <color=#F74848>1</color> AP after combat, effective up to <color=#F74848>1</color> time per turn.

600931.name: Phase Shift 1
600931.SpecificEffects: At the start of action, <buf ID=900089>[Balance]</buf> the HP% of all intact parts.

600033.name: Adaptive Warfare 1
600033.SpecificEffects: At the end of the action, if an Active Attack was not initiated this turn, an extra <color=#F74848>2</color> tiles can be moved.

600934.name: Phase Shift 2
600934.SpecificEffects: After <buf ID=900089>[Balance]</buf>, all intact parts additionally recover <color=#F74848>10%</color> HP.

600935.name: Phase Shift 3
600935.SpecificEffects: When a part is destroyed, DMG Taken <color=#F74848>-15%</color>.

600936.name: Phase Shift 4
600936.SpecificEffects: After taking damage, if HP is below <color=#F74848>50%</color>, trigger <buf ID=900089>[Balance]</buf> and repair <color=#F74848>1</color> destroyed part. Can trigger again after <color=#F74848>3</color> turns.

601041.name: Zero-sum Game 1
601041.SpecificEffects: At the start of turn, if there are enemies carrying <buf ID=6010502>[Magnetic Lock-On]</buf>, immediately release <skill mainSkill=601051>[Vengeful Strike β]</skill>

600043.name: Entrenched 4
600043.SpecificEffects: <buf ID=900022>[Guard]</buf> can now be triggered an unlimited number of times per turn.

601046.name: Zero-sum Game 4
601046.SpecificEffects: <skill mainSkill=601050>[Vengeful Strike]</skill> and <skill mainSkill=601051>[Vengeful Strike β]</skill> base attack count increases by <color=#F74848>+1</color>.
